scripts.dev: echo 'Run in separate terminals: yarn dev:frontend && yarn dev:backend && yarn dev:admin'
scripts.dev:backend: cd apps/backend && uv run litestar --app main:app run --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 -d
scripts.dev:admin: cd apps/admin && uv run python manage.py runserver 0.0.0.0:8010
scripts.lint: yarn lint:frontend && yarn lint:backend && yarn lint:admin
scripts.lint:backend: cd apps/backend && UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/uv-cache uv run ruff check .
scripts.lint:admin: cd apps/admin && UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/uv-cache uv run ruff check .
scripts.typecheck: yarn typecheck:frontend && yarn typecheck:backend && yarn typecheck:admin
scripts.typecheck:backend: cd apps/backend && UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/uv-cache uv run mypy .
scripts.typecheck:admin: cd apps/admin && UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/uv-cache uv run mypy .
